reason: I don't pay anyone before the thing is in my hands, and they want the item price and fee up front for a new page I've never heard of. On top of that it's 2 to 3 weeks, and 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is a lot for my family.
objection: Paying first to a new online service and then waiting weeks, with no way to know if the item or my money will ever show up.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me pay everything in cash when the item arrives at my door, or a friend or relative I trust getting their order from them first.
